“the electric oven has an approx. three times greater environmental impact than the gas one, in terms of climate change, freshwater and marine ecotoxicities, while for ozone depletion, fossil and metal depletion and natural resource transformation the results are similar with a slight dominance (about 2–5%) of the electric oven”.

the electric oven has a higher environmental impact than the gas one in the Italian context.
the electric oven is not a sustainable alternative to the gas oven, at least in the Italian context.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the gas oven has a lower environmental impact than the electric oven, in the Italian context.
, for the Italian context, a gas oven is preferable to an electric oven.
, in the Italian context and considering the environmental impacts, the gas oven has a higher environmental performance with respect to the electric oven.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the environmental impacts of electric and gas appliances depend on the electricity grid mix and the energy carrier used, respectively, and this aspect should be taken into consideration in the design phase of the product.
